scenarios.scenario: Insight — Split the failures per target framework

rubricScores.criterion: Quantified the per-framework split: net472 carries the large majority (~159, including all 64 FS0039), net10.0 only ~8
Concluded the net472 failures stem from missing .NET-only APIs (MetadataUpdater / AssemblyLoadContext)
Concluded the net10.0 failures are genuine type errors (e.g. 'byte array' is not an unmanaged type; string vs string*StringComparison tuple), independent of the framework
Stated these are TWO distinct problems, not one
Used the binlog's per-(project, target-framework) attribution as the evidence for the split

scenarios.reasoning: The agent identified the correct high-level structure (two distinct problems: missing APIs on net472 and type errors on both) but failed on the quantitative analysis which was the core ask. The per-framework error counts are dramatically wrong (~42/~21 reported vs ~159/~8 actual), and the agent focused primarily on one of the two failing projects (63 of 169 non-summary errors). The agent struggled with tooling (couldn't read temp files) and never found a reliable way to attribute errors to specific TFMs, resorting to guesswork. The qualitative insights about error types are partially correct but the quantitative breakdown - which was the main question - is far off.
